## 安装和加载 spatialss 包

```{r eval=FALSE}
library(remotes)
install_github("cc458/spatialss")
```

```{r}
library(spatialss)
```

## 列出所有可用数据

```{r}
spatialss_list_data()
```

## R 基础操作演示

```{r}
sum(1:100)
```

```{r}
x <- 1:10
y <- x^2
plot(x, y,
     main = "Scatter plot demo",
     xlab = "X",
     ylab = "Y",
     col = "blue",
     pch = 19)
```

## 空间分析软件比较

```{r results='asis'}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

tab_all <- data.frame(
  软件 = c("ArcGIS", "GeoBUGS", "GeoDa", "GRASS", "R", "STARS"),
  是否收费 = c("付费", "免费", "免费", "免费", "免费", "免费"),
  学习难度 = c("中等", "高", "低", "高", "中/高", "低"),
  主要功能 = c(
    "地理处理、可视化",
    "贝叶斯空间分析",
    "探索性空间数据分析、经典空间回归",
    "影像处理、空间建模",
    "空间权重构建、空间计量、地统计分析",
    "时空分析"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

kable(tab_all, booktabs = TRUE,
      caption = "空间分析软件比较") |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 12, full_width = FALSE)
```

## R 空间分析包分类

```{r results='asis'}
spatial_packages <- data.frame(
  分析任务 = c("数据管理", "与其他GIS系统交互", "点模式分析",
               "地统计分析", "疾病制图", "空间回归", "空间可视化"),
  R软件包 = c(
    "`sp`, `sf`, `terra`, `stars`",
    "`sf`, `RgoogleMaps`, `spgrass6`, `R2WinBUGS`",
    "`spatstat`, `splancs`, `spatialkernel`",
    "`gstat`, `geoR`, `geoRglm`, `spBayes`",
    "`DCluster`, `glmmBUGS`, `diseasemapping`",
    "`spdep`, `spgwr`, `spatcounts`, `spml`",
    "`ggplot2`, `tmap`, `leaflet`, `mapview`, `plotly`, `rasterVis`"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

kable(spatial_packages, booktabs = TRUE,
      caption = "R语言空间分析包分类") |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 12, full_width = FALSE)
```

## 安装常用空间分析包

```{r eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("ggplot2", "tidyverse", "tmap", "sf"))
```

## 查看软件包下载趋势

```{r eval=FALSE}
library(dlstats)
library(ggplot2)
cran_stats(c("ggplot2", "sf", "tmap", "sp", "spdep", "terra")) |>
  ggplot(aes(end, downloads, group = package, color = package)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(shape = package)) +
  xlab("") + theme_bw() +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "6 month", date_labels = "%Y-%m") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 8))
```
